title: Proposal
description: Business proposal or bid document submitted to potential clients. Contains proposal details, pricing, client information, submission dates, validity period, and current status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the proposal record

title.description: Title or subject of the proposal

client_id.description: Foreign key reference to the client or prospect the proposal is submitted to

description.description: Detailed description of the proposed solution, services, or project scope

value.description: Total proposed value or price for the services or project

currency.description: ISO currency code for the proposal value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

status.description: Current status of the proposal (e.g., draft, submitted, under-review, accepted, rejected, expired)

submitted_date.description: Date and time when the proposal was submitted to the client

valid_until.description: Expiration date after which the proposal terms are no longer valid

created_by.description: Full name of the person who created or authored the proposal
